# Protocols

This section is generated automatically from every Markdown file in [`protocol/`](protocol/): each time this document is rendered, it picks up whatever protocols exist in that folder, in numerical order, without needing to be edited by hand.

```{r}
#| label: protocols-listing
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

protocol_files <- list.files("protocol", pattern = "\\.md$")
protocol_numbers <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("^([0-9]+)_.*", "\\1", protocol_files)))
protocol_order <- order(protocol_numbers, protocol_files)
protocol_files <- protocol_files[protocol_order]
protocol_numbers <- protocol_numbers[protocol_order]

for (i in seq_along(protocol_files)) {
  f <- protocol_files[i]
  title <- sub("^[0-9]+_", "", f)
  title <- sub("\\.md$", "", title)
  title <- gsub("_", " ", title)
  substr(title, 1, 1) <- toupper(substr(title, 1, 1))
  cat("\n\n## Protocol ", protocol_numbers[i], " \u2013 ", title, " {.unnumbered}\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(readLines(file.path("protocol", f), warn = FALSE), sep = "\n")
}
```
